SELECT count(*) line_rows, count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)) distinct_lines, count(distinct sales_line_id) distinct_ids, sum(quantity) qty, sum(net_amount) net, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), sum(case when quantity<=0 then 1 else 0 end) nonpos, sum(case when staff_purchase_flag then quantity else 0 end) staff_qty
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND cp.category='Paint & Decorating'
AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(distinct f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(l.sale_date, r.business_date) d, l.units, r.units_sold, l.net, r.net_sales_before_returns, l.rc, r.receipts
FROM l FULL JOIN (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02') r ON r.business_date=l.sale_date
WHERE l.units IS DISTINCT FROM r.units_sold OR l.net IS DISTINCT FROM r.net_sales_before_returns OR l.rc IS DISTINCT FROM r.receipts ORDER BY 1
calls.output_preview:
d | units | units_sold | net | net_sales_before_returns | rc | receipts
(0 rows)
